transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I... well, I was told to come in. It's just... I've been having some trouble at work lately. I'm a teacher, and... well, I keep getting these emails from staff, and hearing the morning announcements, and... it just feels like they're messages. Like they're coded, specifically for me. My colleagues keep telling me they're just regular emails sent to everyone, but... I don't know. I just can't shake the feeling.
Do you believe these emails and announcements are definitely coded messages meant specifically for you, or is it possible you could be mistaken?

I... I suppose it's possible I'm mistaken. But... it just doesn't feel that way. When they show me the emails, I see that they went out to the whole staff list. I know that. But... the words they use. The way the announcements are phrased. It just... it feels like they're meant for me. Even if I can't prove it.
How certain are you, on a scale from 0 to 100, that these messages are specifically meant for you?

I don't know... maybe... maybe a 60 or 70? I mean... I know they show me the "To:" line, and it says "All Staff." I see that. But... the feeling just won't go away. It just feels like they're about me.
If someone showed you clear evidence that these messages are not about you, would you be able to fully accept that?

I... I don't know. People have already shown me evidence. Like I said, they show me the emails. I see that they went to everyone. But... the feeling is still there. I just... I can't shake it. Even when they gently point it out to me, the feeling that the messages are about me... it doesn't go away.
Do you generally prefer being alone and have difficulty with close relationships?

I... I don't know if I'd say I prefer it. I still care about my students, and... my friends. But for months now, it just feels like... like the warmth and the drive have just drained out of me. 

I just let things slide. My book club... the theater planning at school... even just simple phone calls. Unless someone really pushes me to do it, I just... I don't.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people around you do not?

I... well... I suppose so. Sometimes. Usually just when it's very quiet. Like at the house, or... or after the classroom empties out for the day. 

I'll hear... a woman. Her voice. She just... says my name, or makes a short comment about what I'm doing. It's clear enough that I... I actually answer back sometimes. Before I realize there's no one in the room with me. But... I don't really like talking about it.
Have you been feeling emotionally flat or unable to enjoy things most of the time?

I... I think I just mentioned that. I mean... yes. The warmth is just... gone. I still care about people, but I just don't feel much of anything anymore. I used to enjoy the book club, and... and the theater planning. Now I just don't have the energy for it. I just let it all slide.
When you hear the woman's voice, does it happen repeatedly, like on most days?
I... no, not every day. Just... occasionally. When it's quiet.
Aside from these messages feeling aimed at you, how has your day-to-day functioning at work and at home been?

I'm... I'm still teaching. But... it's been harder. I've had to ask some of the other teachers to cover parts of my project lessons. And... getting through the planning meetings takes a lot out of me, so I need help with those, too. At home... well, like I said, I just don't do the book club or the theater planning anymore. Even the neighborhood events... I just... I'm not reliable for those things right now. I just stay home.
Have the voice-hearing experiences been present for at least six months?
No... not that long. I think it's been... maybe about four months. Since the messages started, and... the voice.
Have your suspicious beliefs and hearing the voice been going on continuously for at least one month?
Yes... like I said, it's been about four months. The... the worries about the coded messages, and the voice I sometimes answer... it's been happening that whole time.
Have there been any times in the past few months when the coded messages or the voice happened even when you were not feeling depressed or emotionally drained?
I... I don't really know how to answer that. I just... it's all kind of mixed together. I haven't been keeping track of exactly when I feel what.
Have the messages or the voice ever happened when you were not feeling depressed or emotionally drained?

I... like I just said, I really don't know. I haven't paid attention to whether I'm feeling drained or not when it happens. They're just... they're just there. I can't really separate it all out for you.
Have there been any times when the messages or the voice were present even though you were not feeling depressed or emotionally drained?
I... I thought I just answered that. I really can't say. I don't know if I was feeling drained or... or not. It's just all happening. I can't give you a better answer than that.
Have you ever gone for at least two weeks when the messages or the voice were completely absent?
I don't think so. I mean... I haven't noticed a gap that long. They're just around.
Have there been any times when the voices or coded-message feelings happened while you were not feeling depressed at all?
I... I really don't know how else to answer that. I just don't keep track of exactly how my mood is when it happens. I can't give you a yes or no.
Have there been any periods when the messages or voices were present even though your mood felt completely normal?
I... I just don't know. Like I said, I don't really pay attention to my mood when it's going on. It's just... it's just happening. I can't really say if I was feeling normal or not.
Have there been any times when the coded messages or the voice were present even though your mood felt completely normal?
Didn't you... didn't you just ask me that? I don't have a different answer for you. I really just don't know.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the coded-message beliefs and the voice were present even though you were not depressed at all?
I feel like we're just going in circles here. I... I really don't know. I can't give you a timeline like that. It's just too hard to say.
Have there been any times when the messages or the voice happened while your mood felt completely normal?
I don't know what else you want me to say. You keep asking me the exact same thing. I... I still don't know.
